We need to propose a retrosynthesis route up to 5 steps, leaves must be commercially available, total price <=9999. Need to output JSON route.

We have target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We have applied template 42530 gave precursors: product? The result shows a tuple: (('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=N)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO', 'O'),). So two precursors: a complex molecule and O (oxygen?). Actually 'O' likely water? The template seems to break an ester to give alcohol and something else? The retro template maybe forms an amide? Not sure.

We need to find commercially available precursors. Let's examine the precursor: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=N)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO". That's similar to target but with a carboxamide (C(=N)O) instead of carboxylic acid? Actually target has C(O)=O (carboxylic acid). The precursor has C(=N)O (amidic). So we could hydrolyze amide to acid later.

We need to check if that precursor is commercially available. Use is_buyable.
